rules.name: SEBI / NSDL registration number aur portal verification
rules.trigger: message/chat/screenshot me SEBI, NSDL, SCORES, SMART ODR ka zikr ya registration-number claim ho
rules.action: 3 cheezein check hoti hain, sirf teen: (1) number ka FORMAT — INZ/INH/INA/INB + 9 digits; (2) portal domain official list me hai ya lookalike (sebi.gov.in, scores.gov.in, smartodr.in, nsdl.co.in, nseindia.com, bseindia.com); (3) naam demo-debarred/watch list me hai. Galat-format number (jaise “SEBI12345”), ya “SEBI” + paisa/join ka zikr bina number ke → red flag. Sirf awareness message me SEBI ka zikr ho (koi money-ask nahi) → koi flag nahi.
rules.honest_limit: Hum “registered hai” CERTIFY nahi karte aur live SEBI registry download bhi nahi karte (offline demo) — user ko sebi.gov.in par khud verify karne bhejte hain. Demo defaulter list synthetic hai.

rules.name: Safety-warning ko scam na samajhna (negation handling)
rules.trigger: rule ka keyword mila, par uske aas-paas negation ho — “kabhi bhi OTP share mat karo”, “OTP share karne ko nahi kahenge”
rules.action: dono order pack hote hain (keyword-pehle aur negation-pehle). Negation mila to verdict SEEMS OK (safety-warning) branch me jaata hai, risk-word list ke saath. Override: agar text me asli scam-words bhi hain (guarantee/300%/deposit/safe account/arrest), to negation ka asar nahi hota.
rules.tier: T1 (koi friction nahi) — par link/portal alag se M3 se check hota hi hai
rules.status: RULE + EVAL (eval set me legit sample isi ke liye rakha hai)
rules.honest_limit: Regex-based negation hai, semantic nahi — teesra-level sarcasm/mixed message miss ho sakta hai; aise case “PAKA NAHI” bucket me jaate hain.

rules.name: analysis se pehle client-side PII redaction
rules.action: phone (6-9 se shuru 10 digit), UPI handle, aadhaar-jaisa 12-digit, account-number pattern device par hi mask hote hain; analysis masked text par chalti hai, UI me “🔒 client-side redaction: N item mask” note dikhta hai. Demo me koi network call nahi hoti — asli text device par hi rehta hai.
rules.honest_limit: Pattern-based masking hai — OCR ke garbled ya naye format wale identifiers bach sakte hain; production me on-device model + user “verify” step chahiye.

rules.name: shortened URL aur instant-gift luring pattern flag
rules.trigger: cutt.ly / bit.ly / tinyurl / rb.gy / is.gd / t.co jaise shortener, ya “special VIP gift”, “withdraw instantly”, “free gift”, “turant withdraw” jaise phrase
rules.action: F29 family → SCAM LIKELY (T3), reasons + “link na kholo, app khud kholo” action, M7 report pack link.
rules.honest_limit: Legit brands bhi kabhi-kabhi shortener use karte hain — isliye message ko akela proof nahi maana jaata; domain/registry check bhi saath chalta hai.

rules.name: “pehle 1 ghante” checklist (paisa jaane ke baad)
rules.trigger: user confirm kare ki fraud payment ho gaya (ya screenshot + txn ID diya)
rules.action: clock ke hisaab se steps: (0–10 min) 1930 par call + bank helpline par freeze request; (10–30 min) cybercrime.gov.in / NCRP par complaint (txn ID/UTR), UPI app me “Report fraud”; (30–60 min) Sanchar Saathi par number report, SEBI SCORES/SMART ODR agar advisory/investment angle hai, screenshots ka chain-of-custody pack (crop + redact + hash) banake rakho.
rules.honest_limit: Recovery ki guarantee koi nahi de sakta — freeze-trace ka nateeja bank/PSP par depend karta hai; hum sirf time-optimised steps dete hain.

rules.name: registration/processing/verification fee, loan-sanction fee, EMI + legal-threat recovery
rules.trigger: “registration fee”, “processing fee”, “advance fee”, “loan approved/sanction”, “EMI pending + personal UPI par pay”, “warna legal action”
rules.action: SCAM LIKELY (T3) + action: koi fee mat bhejo, lender/bank ko official number par call, 1930 + NCRP report.
rules.honest_limit: Asli lenders bhi fee lete hain (processing charge) — par woh aapke account se auto-debit karte hain, kisi personal UPI handle ya link par nahi; yehi line draw ki gayi hai.
rules.borrowed_from: concept base: Kshitijsawant17/PATIBIMB (deterministic pattern rules) (idea only)

rules.name: bank impersonation + “warna freeze ho jayega” pressure
rules.trigger: “OTP batayein/de/share karo”, “PIN daal do”, “CVV share karo”, “account freeze ho jayega”
rules.action: SCAM LIKELY (T3) + “call kaat do”, bank ke official number par callback, 1930 + Sanchar Saathi report.
rules.honest_limit: Bank ke genuine OTP messages “OTP kabhi share na karein” likhkar aate hain — woh R27 negation se alag handle hote hain; par copy-paste scam isi tone me aa sakta hai, isliye sender-ID + link check hamesha chahiye.
rules.borrowed_from: deck rules (R6/R7) ka extension + PATIBIMB-style deterministic patterns (idea only)

rules.name: private-photo/video dhamki se paisa nikalna
rules.trigger: “photo family ko bhej dunga”, “gallery access hai”, “video viral kar dunga”, “private photo”, “screen record”
rules.action: SCAM LIKELY (T3) + zero-payment advice (paise dene ke baad bhi demand rukti nahi), 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in me report, platform par block+report, evidence save karo.
rules.honest_limit: Emotional-support flow demo me simulated hai; production me human/trained counsellor routing chahiye.
rules.borrowed_from: apna (M7 evidence flow ke saath natural fit)

rules.name: “aapki lottery lagi hai” + tax/fee
rules.trigger: lottery / jackpot / inaam / lucky draw / prize + tax|fee|nikalne ke liye
rules.action: SCAM LIKELY (T3) + “aapne participate hi nahi kiya”, koi detail/paisa mat bhejo, message delete na karo (report ke liye), 1930 + Sanchar Saathi.
rules.honest_limit: State lotteries legally exist karti hain, par woh advance fee nahi maangti — isliye trigger me “fee/tax” ka hona zaroori rakha hai.

rules.name: “mera naya number + hospital/accident + urgent paisa”
rules.trigger: naya/new number claim, hospital me hoon, accident, voice clone/AI awaaz, urgent ₹X bhej do, phone band hai
rules.action: SCAM LIKELY (T3) + purane number par khud call, ghar me cross-verify, bina voice/video confirm kiye payment nahi.
rules.honest_limit: Ye template asli emergency me bhi match kar sakta hai — isliye verdict ke saath “verify karne ka tarika” wajib hai, sirf darr nahi failana.

rules.name: “insider news + X% upar jayega” tip group
rules.trigger: stock tip, insider news/tip, trading tip, multibagger, target price, “N% upar jayega”, “abhi paisa bhejo is UPI par”
rules.action: SCAM LIKELY (T3) + paid tip group chhod do, registry check (R26), SEBI SCORES / SMART ODR complaint, screenshots rakh lo.
rules.honest_limit: Hum koi buy/sell/hold ya price prediction nahi dete (SANGYAN guardrail) — sirf tip ke tareeke ka risk batate hain, market view nahi.
rules.borrowed_from: concept base: Kshitijsawant17/PATIBIMB (idea only) + SANGYAN track-A (fake advisors/pump & dump)

rules.name: labelled test set par live precision/recall + honest buckets
rules.trigger: user “Run eval” dabaye (ya judge khud chalaye)
rules.action: 33 labelled messages (22 scam + 11 legit) par wahi engine chalta hai jo user ke paste par chalta hai. Live TP/FP/FN/TN + precision/recall/F1, plus CAUTION bucket alag (soft catch vs friction) aur “paka nahi” bucket. Table me har miss ko `miss` aur har false alarm ko `false-alarm` tag milta hai — chhupte nahi. Button ka count set ki length se aata hai, koi number hardcoded nahi.
rules.status: EVAL (self-authored set — ceiling hai, field accuracy nahi; 3 messages jaan-boojh ke outside-library hain)
rules.honest_limit: Set humne khud likha hai, isliye ye upper-bound hai; out-of-distribution naye variant par recall neeche jayega — isliye “UNCERTAIN/PAKA NAHI” bucket product ka hissa hai.

rules.feature: M7 · fraud confirm → turant teen kadam
rules.name: confirm-fraud emergency action: cyber-cell email + helpline call + payment stop
rules.trigger: user khud “Fraud CONFIRM hai” dabaye (koi auto-detect nahi — confirmation user ka)
rules.action: ek panel khulta hai jisme: (1) 📧 ready email draft — Bihar cyber cell (patnacyberpps-bih@gov.in, sp-cyber@biharpolice.gov.in, cciu-bih@nic.in) + bank nodal officer cc, subject/body me txn ID, UTR, amount, 3 demands, annexure index; user ke tap par mail app khulta hai (auto-send NAHI); (2) 📞 click-to-call dialer — 1930 (cyber financial fraud), 1909 (Sanchar Saathi), bank/PSP official helpline, Bihar cyber cell 9031825975 — saath me 5-line call script (naam/mobile · txn/UTR · amount · kya maanga · complaint number); (3) ⛔ payment-stop request text — txn-wise dispute/chargeback + beneficiary VPA par hold (CFCFRMS) + account temporary freeze/limit + unknown mandate revoke. Golden-hour clock us waqt se chalta hai jab user fraud confirm karta hai.
rules.status: UX + RULE (demo me simulated mail/call; real device par seedha mail app + dialer)
rules.honest_limit: App khud email nahi bhejti aur call nahi karti (privacy + permission) — sirf draft, dialer aur script ready karti hai; actual bhejna/call karna user ke tap par hota hai. Email me aapke full naam/account daalne padte hain.
rules.borrowed_from: user ka requirement (3 Oct 2026): “fraud confirm ho to turant cyber cell ko complaint mail + payment stop ke liye helpline se direct baat”
